# VIRTURA SpacePort

VIRTURA SpacePort is the public archive, station index, and machine-readable layer for the VIRTURA network.

Primary human entry:
https://spaceport.virtura.space/

Public JSON:
https://spaceport.virtura.space/api/manifest.json
https://spaceport.virtura.space/api/works.json
https://spaceport.virtura.space/api/entities.json
https://spaceport.virtura.space/api/articles.json
https://spaceport.virtura.space/api/stations.json
https://spaceport.virtura.space/api/media.json
https://spaceport.virtura.space/api/authority.json

Related public surfaces:
https://ewanqian.site/ - Ewan Qian personal portfolio
https://virtura.space/ - VIRTURA Collective frontstage
https://newsroom.virtura.space/ - essays, reviews, recaps, and media material

Authorship labels:
- personal_work
- team_work
- external_collaboration
- member_independent_work
- artist_context

Content boundary:
Kashiwa / TITAN is external collaboration context.
Murphy Nile and Sihui Xu independent works are artist-context entries until formal work pages are published.
Balloon is canonical spelling.
